items.title_en: Youngest NASA astronaut to walk the moon says UFOs are ‘demonic’ aircraft sent by the devil
items.title_zh: 美国宇航局最年轻的月球漫步宇航员称不明飞行物是魔鬼派来的“恶魔”飞机
items.summary_en: Many grey aliens with scary glowing orange eyes stand in dark. They look forward menacingly, ready for invasion or attack. Their skeletal faces appear sinister and threatening.
items.summary_zh: 许多有着可怕的橙色眼睛的灰色外星人站在黑暗中。他们充满威胁地向前看，准备迎接入侵或攻击。他们的骷髅脸显得阴险而具有威胁性。
items.source: New York Post Weird But True

items.title_en: Work just 3 days a week? Jeff Bezos says AI could change future of work
items.title_zh: 每周只工作 3 天？杰夫·贝佐斯表示人工智能可以改变工作的未来
items.summary_en: Bezos said AI-driven economic changes could give people more freedom to decide how much they want to work.
items.summary_zh: 贝佐斯表示，人工智能驱动的经济变革可以让人们更自由地决定自己想工作多少。

items.title_en: ‘Content creation is the highest paying skill’: Kevin O’Leary shares how artists can earn more
items.title_zh: “内容创作是收入最高的技能”：Kevin O’Leary 分享艺术家如何赚取更多收入
items.summary_en: Shark Tank investor Kevin O’Leary declared content creation the highest-paying skill today, claiming skilled videographers and photographers can build lucrative careers.
items.summary_zh: 《创智赢家》投资者凯文·奥利里 (Kevin O’Leary) 宣称内容创作是当今收入最高的技能，并声称熟练的摄像师和摄影师可以打造利润丰厚的职业。

items.title_en: US engineer poisoned for 18 months by co-worker: ‘He doesn’t deserve a second chance’
items.title_zh: 美国工程师被同事毒害18个月：“他不值得第二次机会”
items.summary_en: Battling health complications years after being poisoned at work, Rong Yuan condemned the legal system for clearing her former colleague’s criminal record despite video proof and cadmium exposure that also sickened her family.
items.summary_zh: 在工作中中毒多年后，荣媛一直在与健康并发症作斗争，她谴责法律系统清除了她前同事的犯罪记录，尽管有视频证据和镉暴露也让她的家人患病。

items.title_en: Woman, 96, marries 18-year-old teenager in record-breaking ceremony
items.title_zh: 96岁女子与18岁少女破纪录结婚
items.summary_en: The unnamed woman married an 18-year-old man in what is said to be the widest-age-gap wedding in the entire country A 96-year-old woman has broken marriage records after tying the knot with a teenager nearly 80 years her junior. The unnamed woman married an 18-year-old man in what is said to be the widest age gap wedding in Mexico - a staggering 78 years. The ceremony was held in Quintana Roo, a state on the Yucatán Peninsula in southeastern Mexico - the same state that's home to Cancún, a popular holiday…
items.summary_zh: 这名未透露姓名的女子与一名18岁男子结婚，据说这是全国年龄差距最大的婚礼。一名96岁的女子与一名比她小近80岁的青少年喜结连理，打破了婚姻记录。这名不愿透露姓名的女子与一名 18 岁男子结婚，据称这是墨西哥年龄差距最大的婚礼——年龄差距惊人，长达 78 年。仪式在墨西哥东南部尤卡坦半岛的金塔纳罗奥州举行，该州也是本州

items.title_en: Richa Chadha’s surveillance makeup hack goes viral amid anti-CEC protests
items.title_zh: Richa Chadha 的监控化妆黑客行为在反 CEC 抗议活动中疯传
items.summary_en: Addressing concerns over non-consensual surveillance by authorities at protest sites, actor Richa Chadha posted a detailed makeup tutorial on X, offering demonstrators a creative technique to pote
items.summary_zh: 为了解决当局在抗议现场未经同意进行监控的担忧，演员 Richa Chadha 在 X 上发布了详细的化妆教程，为示威者提供了一种创造性的化妆技巧

items.title_en: ‘Make in India yesterday, pray for us today’: Sridhar Vembu faces backlash over hike freeze
items.title_zh: “昨天的印度制造，今天为我们祈祷”：Sridhar Vembu 因冻结加息而面临强烈反对
items.summary_en: Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu faced sharp criticism on X after freezing employee salary hikes, citing rising AI expenses, just days after urging Indian tech professionals in the US to return home.
items.summary_zh: Zoho 创始人 Sridhar Vembu 因人工智能支出上升而冻结员工加薪，而就在几天前敦促在美国的印度科技专业人士回国后，X 遭到了严厉批评。

items.title_en: ‘Just bad owners’: Robot gropes 16-year-old girl in Germany
items.title_zh: “只是坏主人”：机器人在德国猥亵 16 岁女孩
items.summary_en: The Cologne police have launched an investigation to determine how the robot operated during the alleged incident and whether its movements were deliberately controlled remotely.
items.summary_zh: 科隆警方已展开调查，以确定该机器人在涉嫌事件中的操作方式以及其动作是否受到故意远程控制。

items.title_en: Decades in IT, no job offer: Indian-Origin techie considers returning to India
items.title_zh: 从事 IT 数十年却没有工作机会：印度裔技术人员考虑返回印度
items.summary_en: Gautam Dev, who lives in Dallas, Texas, resigned from his software engineering job in September 2024 after his employer asked him to relocate to another state to retain his position.
items.summary_zh: Gautam Dev 居住在德克萨斯州达拉斯市，在雇主要求他搬到另一个州以保留职位后，他于 2024 年 9 月辞去了软件工程工作。

items.title_en: China busts ‘Breaking Bad’-style drug racket led by retired chemistry professor
items.title_zh: 中国捣毁由退休化学教授领导的《绝命毒师》式的贩毒团伙
items.summary_en: The police first noticed that a pharmaceutical company had purchased unusually large quantities of six chemicals used to make a substance illegally used in e-cigarettes.
items.summary_zh: 警方首先注意到一家制药公司购买了异常大量的六种化学品，用于制造非法用于电子烟的物质。
